calibration_note: Prior same-controller calibration detected normal vs all four defect controls 5/5. Its answer key is already known in controller history, so no new blind-calibration claim is fabricated and it is not used to authorize PASS.

sequencing.note: Current queue/producer prose was read before exact-pixel review in this invocation. That prevents a PASS claim under the evidence gate, but does not prevent fail-closed rejection because a concrete visual defect was directly observed.

slant.observation: Readable right lean is present and does not reverse the source direction.

clean_plate.observation: The reviewed clean plate removes the COURSE SELECT lettering without a visible English ghost or replacement rectangle in the target strip.

style.observation: The candidate uses an explicit horizontal_target_ratio=0.8 extension of Noto Sans CJK Bold. In the persisted comparison this flattens Hangul anatomy into broad slab-like forms and does not reproduce the source's rounded segmented silver-techno family. This conflicts with the evidence-gate rule not to stretch Hangul to an arbitrary percentage of English width.

readability.observation: The text is legible, but practical-scale review shows compressed counter-space and distorted character proportions, especially the right half of 선택/택; source-family readability is degraded by over-extension rather than simple size.

glyph_integrity.observation: No missing Hangul syllable is observed, but horizontal stretching materially deforms stroke/counter proportions and makes the final glyph group read as slab-like blocks rather than intact source-faithful lettering.

protected_art.observation: OutRun2/OutRun2SP artwork and non-target atlas content remain visually separated from the localized title.

placement.observation: The title remains inside the exact source bbox with positive margins; the defect is typography/proportion, not geometric escape.

orientation.observation: RAW mirror-Y construction remains consistent with the source/candidate review.

C3.prior_defect_observation: C265 underfill was materially increased in width, but A181R introduced a new over-stretched/generic-family defect; C3 cannot run on a fresh C failure.

required_rework: Preserve the validated A113 clean plate, exact source bbox, positive margins, OutRun2/OutRun2SP artwork and RAW mirror-Y orientation.

Do not target an arbitrary English-width percentage. Remove the 0.80 horizontal-target rule and choose source-faithful Hangul proportions from height, stroke weight, counter-space and family impression.

Use a materially more rounded/segmented silver-techno treatment with open counters and controlled right lean; a somewhat narrower Korean result is acceptable if hierarchy remains strong and the source family is visually closer.
Keep silver gradient/outline/depth restrained and verify practical 100/75/50 plus high zoom before producer PASS.
After material rerender, require a future pixels-first C1 review, then separate exact-SHA C3, PRE_INGAME/user JPG review and NEW actual-game validation.
stop_reason: The repair requires a material typography rerender/family redesign rather than a safe small C corrective edit, so this C1 batch stops after q219.
